entries.6e84fa381f07ad30: Vehicle sales finance and vehicle leasing
entries.71c52d0e6d27e39c: This business designs, manufactures and sells CVs (commercial vehicles) and LCVs (pickup trucks and derivatives), mainly large trucks, buses and small trucks, as well as powertrains and related parts and supplies. In addition to manufacturing and assembly at the company, local production is also carried out, in which overseas Group companies assemble components supplied by the company. Engines are produced in Japan and in Asia. In Japan, the company sells large trucks and buses directly to central government agencies and some large-volume customers, and other sales are made by sales companies such as Isuzu Jidōsha Shutoken Co., Ltd. Overseas, sales are made through the Group's sales network, the sales networks of General Motors Group companies and others, and trading companies and others.
